During a '''battle''' in the [[Berrol's Donn system/Legends|Berrol's Donn system]], the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] defeated the forces of the [[Alliance of Free Planets]]. The battle was part of the larger [[Nagai–Tof War]].<ref name="TEA-" />
